runtime: portable llama.cpp Windows build; inspect official release checksum and --help before use
purpose: Avoid dependency on downloading the full PyTorch CUDA wheel if network remains slow. CPU/GPU performance must be measured first.
network_scope: Preparation only. No new listener, tunnel, credentials or installation executed by this config.
privacy: Only local ordered frames and timestamps; no audio, faces/identity, cloud inference or cloud capture of real outputs.
